# Preparing IPUMS data {#c04-prepare-ipums}

IPUMS MICS supplies harmonised background variables across surveys. For foundational reading, those variables are incomplete in countries that administered more than one passage. The limitation is set out in [Getting data from IPUMS MICS](#c01-ipums).

This chapter shows how to keep the IPUMS extract for demographic, household and schooling variables and attach AFLEARN's reading file, which is built from the original UNICEF country files.

The linking identifiers are:

```text
AFLEARN             IPUMS
--------------------------------
cluster        <->  CLUSTER
hhno           <->  HHNO
linech         <->  LINECH
survey/sample  <->  SAMPLE
```

The original MICS6 identifiers underlying these are `HH1` → `CLUSTER`, `HH2` → `HHNO`, and the selected child's line number → `LINECH`. IPUMS's official linking guidance confirms that `SAMPLE`, `CLUSTER`, `HHNO` and the person line number are the key identifying variables in pooled extracts.

[Adding the correct reading data to an IPUMS extract](#c04-ipums-reading) walks through the merge. [Validating the combined file](#c04-validate) checks that multi-passage surveys, Malawi in particular, are represented in full.
